description: Waymo is now doing nearly 500,000 rides a week across 10 cities. Co-CEO Dmitri Dolgov came to the pub to discuss how they moved from scientific research to massive global scaling. He gives a masterclass on the sensor stack (and why you still need Lidar), how they use "Simulation" and "Critic" models to train the AI, and why he believes cars that require human supervision will never naturally evolve into robotaxis. classificationReason: Primarily covers autonomous driving, lidar, vehicle hardware, simulation-based training, and robotaxi deployment at scale.
qualityReason: Likely a highly substantive technical interview with a Waymo leader covering architecture, training, scaling, and economics.
